angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 591,345 km at 38.53 pc = 0.21 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 25.9557 +/- 0.0401 mas (same row, RUWE 1.81): 38.53 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.85 solar radii from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 0.85 solar radii (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684): 591,345 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.8 solar masses from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 0.8 solar masses (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4440 K from Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row K5V, for SIMBAD's spectral type K5V: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt). Spin inclination 60 degrees and rotation period 3.7 d from Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 3.7 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with (https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00684). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row K5V, for SIMBAD's spectral type K5V: Teff (https://www.pas.rochester.edu/~emamajek/EEM_dwarf_UBVIJHK_colors_Teff.txt)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hip-76768.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.482, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 139751: main object type **, Double or Multiple Star
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/MNRAS/441/2361/table1 (Stellar magnetism, age and rotation), column Prot: 3.64 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it
